chunks: And from him (peace be upon him) he said:
For every thing there is a thing that gives it comfort; and a believer finds rest in the company of his fellow believer just as a bird finds comfort amongst its own kind.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual comfort of a believer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the metaphysical principle that every creation has a natural point of repose, highlighting the believer's spiritual home in the company of a fellow believer. This hadith, found in *Kitab al-Mumin*, underscores the theological significance of *al-wala' wa al-bar'a* (affiliation and disaffiliation), framing social bonds among the faithful as a divine instinct akin to a bird returning to its nest. It serves as a practical guide for cultivating deep, authentic connections within the Shia community based on shared faith rather than mere kinship.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 91. It has been reported that Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s) said:
For everything, there is a thing that gives it comfort; and a believer finds rest in the company of his fellow believer just as a bird finds comfort amongst its own kind.
